**[Note 5493677 by kaposts: "These really shouldn't be tagged as bridge or directly connected to foot paths. Walking on hot water pipes is not a good idea and they are not made for it.

Anyone can make their own guesses why a path stops next to some pipes going over a ditch and resumes on the other side, but this shouldn't be an option for router.

And it's not like this is only way to cross an giant obstacle in the middle of nowhere.

I doubt any software expects to be trolled by "this is a bridge" and "it's also round slippery death trap filled with scolding hot water"

Any strong objections if remove the bridge tags? I am fine with keeping the informal foot paths."](https://www.openstreetmap.org/note/5493677)**
Contributor: kaposts
Action: opened
Comment: These really shouldn't be tagged as bridge or directly connected to foot paths. Walking on hot water pipes is not a good idea and they are not made for it.
Anyone can make their own guesses why a path stops next to some pipes going over a ditch and resumes on the other side, but this shouldn't be an option for router.
And it's not like this is only way to cross an giant obstacle in the middle of nowhere.
I doubt any software expects to be trolled by "this is a bridge" and "it's also round slippery death trap filled with scolding hot water"
Any strong objections if remove the bridge tags? I am fine with keeping the informal foot paths.
https://www.openstreetmap.org/note/5493677
